Pulled. Local `main` is now `2df32d77dd`, exactly the knot's main — 113 commits merged in, nothing ahead, nothing to push.

Aesel is at **0.8.41** (was 0.8.39), including the new slogan and `aesel/art/stack`, the `$.queryParams` worker API, and the fresh API context. `node --test test/*.test.mjs` printed 628 tests, 619 pass, 0 fail, 9 skipped. `bash test/cli.sh` printed "CLI tests passed." Both context checks say current.

My uncommitted table-inks work came through the merge intact: `cellTone` and `hostInk` are live in `src/render.mjs` and `rich-reply.test.mjs` passes.

One thing went sideways. Your working tree had 122 dirty entries and no clean base to merge onto, so I stashed them first. When I popped the stash back onto the merged tree it could not reapply cleanly, so for 21 files the upstream version now stands where your uncommitted edits were. I saved that pre-pull state at `f2d1f744c2` on branch `wip-before-aesel-pull-2026-11-09` before dropping the stash.

| Affected | What is upstream now |
|---|---|
| `papers/metadata.json` | revision counts |
| `danzballet.studio/` 6 images and `og-src.html` | ig assets |
| `system/public/aesel/stack.{pdf,png,svg}` | rendered stack art |
| `ScoreCard.swift`, `WaltzCharts.swift`, `InputLatencyProbe.swift`, `RasterArtworkCache.swift`, five MenuBand tests, `docs/oskie/word-toys.md` | newer upstream versions |

Everything else is as you left it, including your `aesel/src/render.mjs`, `aesel/src/handle-colors.mjs` and `aesel/test/rich-reply.test.mjs` edits, plus every untracked directory.

Do you want those 21 restored from the WIP branch?

Machine updated. Everything on this Mac now runs from `2df32d77dd`.

| Thing | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `~/Applications/Aesel.app` | 0.8.18 | **0.8.19** |
| `Aesel Host` runtime (launchd helper) | Oct 8 copy | current `aesel/src` |
| `ac` / `aesel` / `easel` / `aes` | 0.8.39 sources | 0.8.41, symlinks in `~/.local/bin` |
| Repo checkout | 113 behind | knot's main |

The app came from the release DMG, notarized for Jeffrey Scudder, and passes `spctl` as accepted. The old one is kept at `~/Applications/Aesel.previous-0.8.18.app`. The host was reinstalled from the checkout with `node aesel/native/install.mjs`, so no Aesel Host process is still running October code — it relaunched clean, empty error log.

`npm test` in `aesel/` printed 628 tests, 619 pass, 0 fail, 9 skipped, then "CLI tests passed." `ac --version` says 0.8.41.

The app downloads page still advertises 0.8.19, while `aesel.json` on the site is already 0.8.41 — the DMG lags the tarball by design, so the app is as fresh as the released build gets.

I did not run `ac-deploy`. That stays yours.

Deployed. Production is serving `2df32d77dd` — the same commit as the knot and this machine.

`ac-deploy` finished with "Done. lith deployed to lith.aesthetic.computer", then verified: database answering, `✓ serving 2df32d77dd`, `✓ products 8bf0d403cd`, `· Aesel 0.8.41`. A second `ac-deploy --verify` printed the same three lines. aesthetic.computer returns 200, and `aesel.json` serves 0.8.41 with the matching sha256.

Cloudflare purged for aesthetic.computer, prompt.ac and danzballet.studio; Caddy reloaded; the menuband mirror was already up to date.
